summary: Petition under Sections 79(1)(c) and 79(1)(k) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 65 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 seeking extension of Scheduled Commercial Operation Date for 198 MW Wind Project in Karur District, Tamil Nadu for the purpose of extension in waiver from payment of Inter-State Transmission System Charges under Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) (Fourth Amendment) Regulations, 2025 read with the Office Order dated 30.07.2025, Committee’s Report’s dated 26.11.2025 and 11.03.2026 and Addendum dated 14.01.2026 issued by this Hon’ble Commission. **Parties Present:** Shri Venkatesh, Advocate, TPREL Shri Suhael Buttan, Advocate, TPREL Ms. Punyam Bhutani, Advocate, TPREL Shri Nikunj Bhatnagar, Advocate, TPREL Ms. Pallavi Saigal, Advocate, CTUIL The Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Petitioner/ TPREL”) has filed the present Petition seeking extension of Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (SCOD) and consequent waiver from payment of ISTS Charges under Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 (hereinafter referred to as the “2020 Sharing Regulations”). The Petitioner has made the following Prayers: - _(b) Hold and declare that the SCOD of the Petitioner’s 198 MW Wind Project at Karur shall stand extended and treated as 04.02.2026, in terms of Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the CERC (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 (as amended), read with the Office Order dated 30.07.2025 and the Addendum dated 14.01.2026, the delay being solely attributable to non-readiness of the CTS and not to the Petitioner;_ - _(c) Consequently, hold and declare that the Petitioner’s Project is entitled to continuation of full waiver from payment of ISTS charges in terms of Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the CERC (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 (as amended), read with the Office Order dated 30.07.2025 issued by this Hon'ble Commission up to 04.02.2026, i.e., actual COD of the Project; and/or_ - _(d) Pass such further order(s) and direction(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case._ - (d) On 07.09.2023, the Petitioner submitted an application under the ‘Land BG Route’ for - (h) Despite timely planning and execution, the Project encountered multiple external impediments, none attributable to the Petitioner. - (j) On 29.09.2025, the Petitioner filed its application to the Committee constituted under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the 2020 Sharing Regulations, seeking recommendation for extension of SCOD and the consequent recommendation of extension of waiver from payment of ISTS charges for its 198 MW Wind project. - (p) As per the findings and recommendations of the Committee, it is evident that the Committee has, upon due examination and prudence check, categorically concluded that the delay was solely on account of continued non-availability of the CTS and ROWrelated litigation, both of which were beyond the control of the Petitioner. - (q) The Petitioner has approached this Commission in terms of the Addendum dated 14.01.2026 issued by this Commission seeking extension of SCOD for 198 MW Wind connectivity for the purpose of extension in waiver from payment of ISTS Charges. **3.** The Commission admitted the Petition and directed CTUIL to file its reply, including the status of the transmission system required for the effectiveness of the GNA granted to the Petitioner. **4.** The learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Reports of the Committee and the recommendations therein may be considered, and the matter may be reserved for order. Further, at the request of learned counsel for CTUIL, the Commission permitted CTUIL to file its compliance affidavit within a week. Subject to the above, the matter was reserved for Order. # ** Submissions of CTUIL in Compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 29.06.2026: ** CTUIL, vide affidavit dated 07.07.2026, submitted the anticipated CoD of the transmission systems required for the effectiveness of the GNA granted to the Petitioner, based on the records maintained by CTUIL and the Minutes of the 53rd JCC Meeting of the Southern Region held on 16.03.2026, as 30.6.2026. **5.** We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and the Respondent, and the documents placed on the record. The following issue arises for our consideration: **_Issue 1: Whether the Petitioner’s project is eligible for extension in SCOD and is entitled to a 100% waiver of Inter-State Transmission System charges as if the project had achieved COD on or before 30.06.2025, under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the 2020 Sharing Regulations?_** **9.** The relevant extracts of the Committee’s Report dated 26.11.2025 are as under: _Any further extension, if required, may be considered in accordance with Regulation 13(2)(h) and the CERC Office Order dated 30.07.2025.”_ **10.** The relevant extracts of the Committee’s report dated 11.03.2026 are as under: _ (i) Renewable Energy Implementing Agency or a distribution licensee or an authorized agency on behalf of a distribution licensee or MNRE as per the competent authority in terms of the Power Purchase Agreements, where PPA has been entered into consequent to tariff based competitive bidding, under Section 63 of the Act;_ _ (ii) Commission based on recommendations of Committee to be appointed by the Commission, for cases other than covered in sub-clause (i) of this Clause.
